# Sinebrychoff Art Museum

Sinebrychoff Art museum has the most important collection of Old Masters´ works in Finland.

![Two peacocks and plants, with a cityscape in the background.](https://sinebrychoffintaidemuseo.fi/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/11/stilleven_2_pauwen_woudenberg_DSC2000_klaar-951x1024.jpg)

Exhibition

24.9.2026–10.1.2027

Exhibition

3.3.2026–29.8.2027

![Room with baroque furniture and green walls filled with 17th century paintings.](https://sinebrychoffintaidemuseo.fi/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2021/01/Siff-kotimuseo-tyohuone-1024x751.jpg)

## [Tickets](https://sinebrychoffintaidemuseo.fi/en/opening-hours-tickets-and-getting-here/)

Standard admission at the ticket office €21  
Standard admission online €19  
Discounted admission €13  
Under 18-year-olds €0  
Museum Card: free entry

[How do I buy tickets online?](https://sinebrychoffintaidemuseo.fi/en/how-do-i-buy-tickets-online/)
